# Madison's Footsteps

> > Solo female travel guides and destination resources covering Europe, Southeast Asia, South America, and beyond.

Madison's Footsteps is a travel blog by Madison focusing on solo female travel experiences, safety tips, and comprehensive destination guides across Portugal, Colombia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and other international destinations. The site emphasizes responsible travel practices and building connections while traveling solo.

## Key Topics

- Solo female travel
- Europe travel guides
- Southeast Asia destinations
- Portugal (Lisbon, Porto, Madeira)
- Colombia (Cartagena, Santa Marta)
- Indonesia
- Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur)
- Thailand
- Vietnam (Hoi An)
- Vienna
- Gili Trawangan
- Roatan
- Travel safety tips
- Solo travel photography
- Responsible travel

## Essential Travel Resources

- [Destinations](https://madisonsfootsteps.com/destinations): Directory of 22+ destinations across Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand & Vietnam
- [Solo Female Travel Guides](https://madisonsfootsteps.com/solo-female-travel-guides): Solo female travel guides covering Vienna, Europe, Gili Trawangan & Hoi An

## South America Travel Guides

- [Colombia Travel Guides](https://madisonsfootsteps.com/colombia-travel-guides): Colombia guides featuring Cartagena & Santa Marta on the Caribbean coast
